يهتلك (form VIII)
# يَهْتَلِكُ (yahtaliku) /jah.ta.li.ku/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# يُهْتَلَكُ (yuhtalaku) /juh.ta.la.ku/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# يَهْتَلِكَ (yahtalika) /jah.ta.li.ka/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِهْتَلَكَ (ihtalaka)
# يُه
